title: Math Education Digital Shadows for facilitating learning with LLMs: Math performance, anxiety and confidence in simulated students and AIs
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a dataset (MEDS) to benchmark mathematical performance and socio-cognitive traits (like math anxiety and self-efficacy) in LLMs. While 'religious_beliefs' is included as a demographic attribute for simulated personas, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religious topics, morals, or ethics as a core component of its research.
